name: Kether
traditional: Undivided source before differentiated force or form.
basic: Begin with potential, before asking how it becomes a particular activity.
worlds: Each Sephirah is considered in all four worlds: Atziluth, Briah, Yetzirah and Assiah. Do not identify a Sephirah with only one world.
element: No single exclusive elemental attribution in this introductory table.
version: Hermetic / Golden Dawn-derived table; transliterations normalized
source_note: Common Hermetic teaching convention: divine names with Atziluth, archangels with Briah, angelic orders with Yetzirah and celestial spheres with Assiah. Liber 777 labels some divine and angelic columns within Assiah instead; do not equate these world schemes without checking the edition. Spellings and some names vary.
